import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int next, to, cap;
        long cost;
        Edge(int next, int to, int cap, long cost) {
            this.next = next;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 100010;
    static final int MAXM = 2000020;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;

    static Edge[] e = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int ecnt = 1;
    static int node_cnt;
    static List<Integer>[] g = new List[MAXN];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, long cost) {
        e[++ecnt] = new Edge(head[u], v, cap, cost);
        head[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = new Edge(head[v], u, 0, -cost);
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }

    static class MCMF {
        static int[] cur = new int[MAXN];
        static boolean[] vis = new boolean[MAXN];
        static long[] dist = new long[MAXN];
        static long[] pot = new long[MAXN];
        
        static class Node implements Comparable<Node> {
            int id;
            long key;
            Node(int i, long k) {
                id = i;
                key = k;
            }
            public int compareTo(Node o) {
                return Long.compare(key, o.key);
            }
        }
        
        static PriorityQueue<Node> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
        
        static boolean dijkstra(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, 1, node_cnt + 1, INF);
            System.arraycopy(head, 1, cur, 1, node_cnt);
            dist[t] = 0;
            pq.offer(new Node(t, 0));
            
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int u = pq.poll().id;
                if (vis[u]) continue;
                vis[u] = true;
                
                for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = e[i].next) {
                    int v = e[i].to;
                    long w = pot[u] + e[i ^ 1].cost - pot[v];
                    if (e[i ^ 1].cap != 0 && dist[u] + w < dist[v]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                        pq.offer(new Node(v, dist[v]));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= node_cnt; ++i)
                pot[i] = Math.min(pot[i] + dist[i], INF);
            
            if (!vis[s]) return false;
            Arrays.fill(vis, 1, node_cnt + 1, false);
            return true;
        }
        
        static int dfs(int u, int t, int f) {
            if (u == t || f == 0) return f;
            int pushed = 0;
            vis[u] = true;
            
            for (int i = cur[u]; i != 0; i = e[i].next) {
                cur[u] = i;
                if (e[i].cap != 0) {
                    int v = e[i].to;
                    int flow;
                    if (!vis[v] && pot[v] + e[i].cost == pot[u] &&
                        (flow = dfs(v, t, Math.min(f, e[i].cap))) != 0) {
                        e[i].cap -= flow;
                        e[i ^ 1].cap += flow;
                        pushed += flow;
                        f -= flow;
                        if (f == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            vis[u] = false;
            return pushed;
        }
        
        static int total_flow = 0;
        static long total_cost = 0;
        
        static void run(int s, int t) {
            while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
                int flow = dfs(s, t, (int)INF);
                total_flow += flow;
                total_cost += (long)flow * pot[s];
            }
        }
    }

    static int src = 1, dst = 2, n, m, k, c, d;

    static int idx(int t, int x) {
        return t * n + x + 2;
    }

    static void layer(int t) {
        node_cnt += n;
        
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; ++p) {
                    add_edge(idx(t, u), idx(t + 1, v), 1, d * (2L * p - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            add_edge(idx(t, u), idx(t + 1, u), Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }
        
        add_edge(idx(t + 1, 1), dst, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c * (t + 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        node_cnt = n + 2;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(src, idx(0, a), 1, 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            g[u].add(v);
            g[v].add(u);
        }
        
        add_edge(idx(0, 1), dst, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + k; ++i) {
            layer(i);
        }
        
        MCMF.run(src, dst);
        System.out.println(MCMF.total_cost);
    }
}
